tasks.title: Initialize Go Project & Directory Structure
actions: Initialize `go.mod` for `github.com/mesosphere/mesosphere` (or local module name).
Set up directory structure (`cmd/`, `pkg/core/`, `pkg/git/`, `pkg/server/`, `web/`).
Create minimal `main.go` entry point.
Ensure `go build` compiles cleanly.

successCriteria: `go build ./...` succeeds without errors.
Directory skeleton matches DESIGN.md package structure.

tasks.title: Implement Configuration Data Model & Persistence Service
actions: Define `Config`, `Settings`, `UISettings`, `RepositoryConfig`, `CredentialsConfig` Go structs matching Section 5.1.
Implement discovery/resolution for default path (`~/.mesosphere/config.yaml`).
Implement `LoadConfig()` using YAML parsing (e.g. `gopkg.in/yaml.v3`).
Implement `SaveConfig()` to serialize updated configuration to disk safely.
Implement default config generation if config file does not exist.

successCriteria: Unit tests verify loading valid config, saving updated config, and handling missing config file with defaults.
Supports multiple repositories and UI state options.

tasks.title: Implement Web Application Skeleton & Embedding Stub
actions: Initialize frontend build setup in `/web` (HTML/CSS/JS or framework like Vue/React/Svelte).
Configure build output to standard static assets in `web/dist/` with relative asset links (`./assets/...`).
Set up `pkg/server/embed.go` using `//go:embed all:dist` to embed `web/dist` at compile time.
Provide a fallback minimal `index.html` in `web/dist` so Go build works even before full UI build.

successCriteria: `//go:embed` compiles properly in Go package `pkg/server`.
Build scripts generate static assets in `web/dist/`.

tasks.title: Implement Git Command Execution Engine
actions: Implement Go wrapper around system `git` executable (`os/exec`).
Implement methods for `Commit(repoPath, filePath, message)`, `Pull(repoPath)`, `Push(repoPath)`, `Fetch(repoPath)`.
Implement `GetDocHistory(repoPath, filePath)` and `GetDocVersionContent(repoPath, filePath, commitHash)`.
Implement `CheckRepoStatus(repoPath)` to detect uncommitted local changes and behind/ahead commit counts relative to tracking branch.
Handle git process error output and git conflict detection during pull/push.

successCriteria: Unit tests against temporary git repositories verify commit, status check, history extraction, and pull/push handling.

tasks.title: Implement Repository Working Context Resolver Engine
actions: Implement repository list and resolution logic in core logic layer.
Implement `GetRepositoryContext(cwd, repoFlag)`.
If explicit `repoFlag` supplied, match against config repository IDs or paths.
If `repoFlag` omitted, match `cwd` against configured repository paths.
If `cwd` is not a configured repo and no `repoFlag` provided, return an explicit context resolution error.

successCriteria: Tests confirm matching `cwd` to configured repos.
Tests confirm explicit `repoFlag` override.
Tests confirm error returned when `cwd` is unconfigured and no flag passed.

tasks.title: Implement Document Discovery and Version History Engine
actions: Implement file tree walker in repo root to locate all `.md` and `.txt` files.
Implement `ListDocuments(repoPath)` returning relative file paths and summaries.
Implement `ListDocumentVersions(repoPath, docPath)` using git history wrapper.
Implement `GetDocument(repoPath, docPath, version)` returning document text (current HEAD if `version` empty, or specified historical commit content).

successCriteria: Unit tests find all markdown files in a test git repo.
Unit tests correctly extract historical commit version content.

tasks.title: Implement Document Save Core Logic
actions: Implement `SaveDocument(repoPath, docPath, content, commitMsg)`.
Write raw content to target file path on disk within repository.
Execute local git commit via git engine with clear commit message (`update(mesosphere): <filename>`).

successCriteria: Unit test saves modified content to disk and verifies a new git commit was created.

tasks.title: Implement Common Task Representation Model & Pluggable Framework Translator Engine
actions: Define `CommonTask` struct as specified in Section 5.2 (`CardID`, `Scope`, `ValidationGate`, `IsBlocked`, `BlockerID`, `Status`, `RawContent`, `FilePath`, `RepoID`, `ExtraFields`).
Implement framework detection and schema translation adapters for GitHub Spec Kit, OpenSpec, BMAD-METHOD, Amazon Kiro, Augment Cosmos, and simple JSON/Markdown checkbox task formats.
Implement `ListTasks(repoPath)` scanning repository for supported task files.
Implement `GetTask(repoPath, taskID)` retrieving specific task details.

successCriteria: Unit tests translate sample task files from different frameworks into `CommonTask` structs.
Verifies field mapping accuracy for CardID, Scope, ValidationGate, IsBlocked, and Status.

tasks.title: Implement Task Edit & Save Core Logic
actions: Implement `SaveTask(repoPath, taskID, rawJSON, commitMsg)`.
Validate JSON payload structure.
Overwrites or updates raw task file on filesystem.
Executes local git commit via git engine (`update(mesosphere): task <taskID>`).

successCriteria: Unit test updates task raw JSON and verifies new local git commit.

tasks.title: Implement Repository Sync & Publish Core Logic
actions: Implement `SyncRepository(repoPath)` executing `git pull`.
Implement `PublishRepository(repoPath)` executing `git pull` followed by `git push`.
Capture git conflict errors during pull and return structured conflict error.
Provide status query logic for unpushed commits and remote divergence.

successCriteria: Unit tests simulate successful publish.
Unit tests simulate conflict detection during publish and verify conflict error reporting.

tasks.title: Implement Cobra CLI Framework & Launcher Logic
actions: Integrate `github.com/spf13/cobra` in `cmd/root.go`.
Implement argument routing: if CLI subcommands provided, delegate to Cobra.
If zero arguments passed or `serve` subcommand executed, launch HTTP server mode.

successCriteria: Running binary with `--help` prints Cobra CLI help menu.
Running binary with zero arguments invokes server entry point.

tasks.title: Implement CLI Commands: Repo & Config Operations
actions: Implement `mesosphere repo list` CLI subcommand using Core Engine `ListRepositories`.
Format output cleanly in stdout (e.g., table or list view).
Support `--json` flag for machine-readable JSON output.

successCriteria: `mesosphere repo list` outputs configured repositories to stdout.

tasks.title: Implement CLI Commands: Document Operations
actions: Implement `mesosphere doc list [--repo <id>]`.
Implement `mesosphere doc versions <doc-path> [--repo <id>]`.
Implement `mesosphere doc get <doc-path> [--version <hash>] [--repo <id>]`.
Use `GetRepositoryContext` to enforce CWD / `--repo` context resolution rules.

successCriteria: CLI commands correctly list docs, list versions, and output current/historical document contents.
Errors out if CWD is not a configured repo and `--repo` is omitted.

tasks.title: Implement CLI Commands: Task Operations
actions: Implement `mesosphere task list [--repo <id>]`.
Implement `mesosphere task get <task-id> [--repo <id>]`.
Enforce working context resolution rules.

successCriteria: CLI commands list tasks and display task details in JSON format.

tasks.title: Implement Agent Skill Definition & Package Integration
actions: Create `.agents/skills/mesosphere-cli/SKILL.md`.
Document available CLI commands, flags, expected inputs, and outputs for AI assistants.
Provide examples for document querying, history lookup, task details retrieval, and repo listing.

successCriteria: `SKILL.md` exists and accurately describes CLI capabilities and argument structure.

tasks.title: Implement Server Engine & REST API Router
actions: Implement `net/http` server with `go-chi/chi` router in `pkg/server`.
Set up `/api/v1` route group.
Set up fallback static asset handler to serve embedded UI assets (`//go:embed web/dist`).

successCriteria: HTTP server starts cleanly on local port.
Requests to static assets return embedded files.

tasks.title: Implement Browser Auto-Launcher Component
actions: Implement `OpenBrowser(url string)` supporting Windows (`cmd /c start`), macOS (`open`), and Linux (`xdg-open`).
Integrate auto-launch trigger into `mesosphere serve` startup routine.

successCriteria: `OpenBrowser` executes OS default browser launcher without throwing unhandled errors.

tasks.title: Implement REST Endpoints: Config & Repo Management
actions: Implement `GET /api/v1/config` & `POST /api/v1/config`.
Implement `GET /api/v1/repos`.
Implement `GET /api/v1/repos/{repoID}/status` returning uncommitted changes and behind counts.

successCriteria: REST endpoint unit tests return 200 OK with valid config and repository lists.

tasks.title: Implement REST Endpoints: Sync & Publish Operations
actions: Implement `POST /api/v1/repos/{repoID}/sync` (`git pull`).
Implement `POST /api/v1/repos/{repoID}/publish` (`git pull` + `git push`).
Return HTTP 409 Conflict when git conflict occurs.

successCriteria: Endpoints return 200 on success and 409 Conflict on git pull failure.

tasks.title: Implement REST Endpoints: Document Operations
actions: Implement `GET /api/v1/repos/{repoID}/docs`.
Implement `GET /api/v1/repos/{repoID}/docs/detail`.
Implement `GET /api/v1/repos/{repoID}/docs/versions`.
Implement `POST /api/v1/repos/{repoID}/docs/save`.

successCriteria: Endpoints list documents, fetch content, fetch versions, and trigger local doc save commits.

tasks.title: Implement REST Endpoints: Task Operations
actions: Implement `GET /api/v1/repos/{repoID}/tasks`.
Implement `GET /api/v1/repos/{repoID}/tasks/{taskID}`.
Implement `POST /api/v1/repos/{repoID}/tasks/{taskID}/save`.

successCriteria: Endpoints list converted tasks, return raw task details, and save modified raw task JSON.

tasks.title: Implement Background Fetch Service
actions: Implement background ticker in HTTP server running every 3 minutes.
Trigger non-blocking `git fetch` for all configured repositories.
Update repo status state so `/api/v1/repos/{repoID}/status` indicates when remote upstream changes exist.

successCriteria: Background ticker triggers fetch without blocking HTTP request handling.
Status API reflects behind count after fetch.

tasks.title: UI: Implement Repository Entry Point Box-Grid Selector & Top Bar
actions: Implement initial box-grid selector view displaying all configured repositories.
Upon selection, render top bar displaying left-aligned selected repo name and right-aligned 'Docs' and 'Tasks' tabs.

successCriteria: UI displays box-grid selector when no repo selected.
UI transitions to show top bar with repository name and section tabs when repo selected.

tasks.title: UI: Implement Navigation & Split View Layout Component
actions: Implement 'Split View' toggle button in UI top bar.
Implement dual-pane layout rendering two independent pane instances.
Apply CSS responsive rule: left/right side-by-side when viewport `width > height`, top/bottom stacked when `viewport height > width`.
Allow each pane to independently choose repo and Docs/Tasks mode (including duplicate combinations).

successCriteria: Split view creates 2 independent view panes.
Layout dynamically switches between row and column based on aspect ratio.

tasks.title: UI: Implement Docs Navigation Menu & Markdown Viewer with Native Mermaid
actions: Implement left-hand menu listing repository documents and directories.
Implement main view rendering selected markdown document.
Integrate bundled Mermaid.js library to render ```mermaid code blocks dynamically into inline SVGs.
Ensure native image rendering for relative repository image assets.

successCriteria: Document list renders repo files.
Markdown and embedded mermaid diagrams render natively on document selection.

tasks.title: UI: Implement Document Editing, Save & Publish Flow
actions: Add bottom-right pencil edit icon to switch rendered doc into plain-text editor.
Change icon to Save button on edit; clicking Save invokes `/api/v1/repos/{id}/docs/save`.
Show 'Publish' button when unpushed changes exist.
Clicking Publish triggers `/api/v1/repos/{id}/publish`, disables button, and displays spinning feedback.
Display error notification modal if publish fails due to git conflicts.

successCriteria: Editing doc and clicking Save sends update and updates commit status.
Publish button handles loading state and git conflict errors.

tasks.title: UI: Implement Tasks Kanban Board with Schema-Derived Columns
actions: Implement Kanban board component rendering tasks into dynamic columns.
Derive columns based on framework schema (binary schema -> 'TO DO' and 'DONE'; explicit status -> 1 column per status).
Render Task Card displaying CardID, truncated Scope text, and status badge.

successCriteria: Binary tasks render in TO DO / DONE columns.
Multi-status tasks render in matching status columns.
Card displays truncated Scope text.

tasks.title: UI: Implement Blocked Task Indicator & Popup Inspector
actions: Ensure tasks with `IsBlocked == true` remain in the 'TO DO' column.
Display red blocked indicator badge on the card.
Show blocker task title on hover tooltip.
Open popup modal displaying blocker task details when blocked indicator is clicked.

successCriteria: Blocked task remains in 'TO DO' column.
Hover reveals blocker title.
Click opens modal with blocker task info.

tasks.title: UI: Implement Task Card Editing, Raw JSON View, Save & Publish Flow
actions: Opening task card displays editable raw JSON view.
Display Save button when JSON changes are made.
Clicking Save invokes `/api/v1/repos/{id}/tasks/{taskID}/save`.
Enable Publish button for task commit and trigger publish flow on click.

successCriteria: Task modal displays raw JSON.
Saving JSON sends API request and triggers local git commit.

tasks.title: UI: Implement Remote Change Notification & Refresh Trigger
actions: Poll `/api/v1/repos/{id}/status` in UI.
When remote changes are detected (`behind > 0`), display top-left refresh icon.
Clicking refresh icon triggers `/api/v1/repos/{id}/sync` (`git pull`), shows spinning feedback, and reloads current view.

successCriteria: Refresh icon appears top-left when repo is behind.
Clicking icon pulls latest changes and updates active view.

tasks.title: End-to-End Build Integration & Single-Binary Assembly Verification
actions: Set up build script/Makefile compiling frontend assets into `web/dist` and executing `go build -o mesosphere`.
Verify complete standalone single-binary functionality in air-gapped test environment.
Verify CLI commands (`repo list`, `doc list`, `task list`) and web UI serve mode.

successCriteria: Single binary `mesosphere` compiles successfully.
Binary runs headlessly or serves embedded web UI properly without external asset dependencies.
